stemMd: Why could Sela's familiarity with the courtyard have come from stories rather than direct experience?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Sela had never heard any family stories.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The town plan omitted every courtyard.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The poem was written before the town existed.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The courtyard had been closed before she was born, and family stories placed a workshop there.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The workshop belonged to a stranger never mentioned by the family.

explanationMd: The first and third paragraphs supply the two relevant facts: physical closure before birth and repeated family accounts. Together they support inherited familiarity without firsthand access.

distractorRationale.e: It was associated with her grandmother.
distractorRationale.b: Only a specific mismatch is discussed.
